programs.title: Ghost Rider
programs.desc: Motorcycle stuntman Johnny Blaze gives up his soul to save his father and becomes the Ghost Rider to fight against Blackheart, the son of Mephistopheles, the devil himself.

programs.title: Lake Placid vs. Anaconda
programs.desc: A genetically modified anaconda and a giant crocodile escape captivity and enter a nearby lake. When the two massive creatures fight, the sheriff tries to prevent the town from being destroyed.

programs.title: Insidious: Chapter 2
programs.desc: Josh Lambert and his family relocate to his mother's old house in the hopes of recovering from past trauma. However, they soon encounter strange and chilling paranormal events.

programs.title: Sardar Udham
programs.desc: Indian revolutionary Udham Singh seeks revenge on Michael O'Dwyer, Punjab's lieutenant governor, after his troops mercilessly kill hundreds of people in the Jallianwala Bagh massacre.

programs.title: XXX: State of the Union
programs.desc: Darius Stone, a former US Navy SEAL, is recruited as a new agent in the XXX program to stop a rogue military faction from overthrowing the US government.

programs.title: After Earth
programs.desc: A father-son duo crash-land on Earth, a millennium after an accident forced humans to evacuate the planet. With the father grievously injured, the son must put his life on the line to secure help.

programs.title: Escape Room: Tournament of Champions
programs.desc: Ben and Zoey find themselves trapped in a series of deadly escape rooms with four others. They try to survive and find a way out as they slowly discover that they have played the game before.

programs.title: The Cable Guy
programs.desc: Chip, a cable technician, sets his sights on befriending Steven, a new customer whom he takes a fancy to. But when Steven spurns their friendship, Chip immediately starts to wreak havoc in his life.

programs.title: The Equalizer 3
programs.desc: As Robert McCall finds himself forming a new bond with the locals of an Italian town, the region's oppression by the Mafia triggers him to protect his people.

programs.title: Zombieland: Double Tap
programs.desc: Columbus, Tallahassee, Wichita and Little Rock set out on a mission to protect the rest of humanity by fighting evolved zombies while also battling their own internal demons.

programs.title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
programs.desc: Miles Morales travels the spider-verse and meets a league of spider-people as he fights a new enemy, the Spot. But upon trying to change his canon event, he is pitted against the other Spider-Men.

programs.title: Sniper: The Last Stand
programs.desc: With time running against him, skilled sniper Brandon Beckett, along with Agent Zero, must commandeer an elite task force to prevent the release of a fatal weapon.

programs.title: Anacondas: The Hunt for the Blood Orchid
programs.desc: A team of researchers is in Borneo to find the blood orchid, a flower that could hold the secret to eternal life. However, the scientists run afoul of the jungle's deadly snakes.

programs.title: Bad Boys II
programs.desc: Mike and Marcus, the Miami Police Department detectives, investigate the flow of drugs into Miami. Their search leads them to a dangerous drug lord who is planning to control the city's drug trade.
